commits.subject: Name NovaScript-Regular as the release does
commits.body:
The release's names differ from what FontForge exported from this file;
it states them as US English names: ID 4 'Nova Script Regular' (FontForge exported 'Nova Script'); ID 6 'NovaScript-Regular' (FontForge exported 'NovaScript').

disclose: The build is flagged italic and named so where the release is not: fontc sets the OS/2 fsSelection ITALIC bit and name ID 2 "Italic" whenever the italic angle is non-zero (-13 here), while FontForge took italic from macStyle, which this source leaves upright; a .glyphs source cannot state otherwise. Decided 2026-10-01: disclose.
